name: Acme Plants
one_liner: A phone app that identifies houseplants from a photo and reminds you when to water each one.
what_it_does: Identifies a houseplant from a photo
Builds a watering schedule for each plant
Explains light and humidity needs for the identified plant
who_it_is_for: New plant owners who forget to water
problems_solved: Not knowing what a houseplant is called
Not knowing how much light a plant needs
pricing: Free with a paid tier for unlimited plants.
best_customer: Someone with ten or more houseplants in an apartment who has lost a few to irregular watering.
misconceptions: People expect it to diagnose bugs and leaf diseases. It only identifies the plant and handles watering.
never_reply_to: Posts about pests, plant diseases or outdoor gardens.
